**Implementation note:** A buy gate below session VWAP by k sigma; also an option of HarvestSleeveSizing.

## Description

Trade deviations from session VWAP back toward VWAP when order flow is not strongly directional.

## Where it may fit

Liquid intraday sessions with balanced two-way flow and repeated price excursions.

## Vehicles

Large-cap stocks, index ETFs and futures.

## Required data

Minute/trade prices and volume, session boundaries, quotes/spreads, timestamps.

## Caveats

VWAP is session-dependent; it is also widely used as an execution benchmark, not just a signal.
